in_sanskrit.name: अशिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings hope, wish or desire.

in_hindi.name: अशिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has the power to fulfill one's own desire.

in_tamil.name: அשிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who comes from the god to give life and prosperity.

in_telugu.name: ఆశితా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the personification of hope, the one who has the power to fulfill the wishes and the one who is the cause of prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Ashita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashita is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ashita’, which means ‘future’ or ‘hope’. In Hindu mythology, Ashita is the goddess of hope and the future. She is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good fortune to those who call upon her.
